## RSS → AI daily digest (free)
1. Edit the feeds, keywords and email addresses in **Config (edit me)**.
2. Open **Gemini (free tier)** and create a *Google Gemini (PaLM) API* credential with your own free key from Google AI Studio.
3. Open **Send digest email** and add an SMTP credential (or disable it and enable **Post to webhook**).
4. Click **Execute workflow** to test, then switch the workflow to **Active**.

Free option B: connect **Groq (free tier, optional)** to the LLM node instead of Gemini.

MIT license · github.com/monriah-studio/n8n-rss-ai-digest

### Want Groq instead?
Delete the link from Gemini, drag Groq's model connector onto **Summarize with LLM**, and add a Groq API credential (free key at console.groq.com). Only one model can be connected.
